rationale: C17 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Both are Red Cross campaign memoranda addressed identically to executive departments, commissions, and agencies; both summarize Red Cross services to servicemen, veterans, families, and blood programs; and both conclude by designating a named official as Chairman of the Government Unit and urging everyone to pledge him "unqualified assistance." That distinctive closing language and matching administrative sequence are substantially stronger than shared topic alone. C22 and C05 are also close predecessors in the same memorandum series, but their operative wording is less exact.

shared_material.explanation: Parallel description of Red Cross assistance to military personnel, veterans, and families.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I have designated the Honorable Douglas McKay, Secretary of the Interior, as Chairman of the Government Unit in the Washington Metropolitan Area. I urge everyone to pledge to Secretary McKay his unqualified assistance.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: To lead the campaign as Chairman of the Government Unit, I have designated the Honorable William McChesney Martin, Jr.... I urge every one to pledge to Mr. Martin his unqualified assistance.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive, materially identical appointment-and-assistance formula, with only the appointee and minor phrasing changed.
